intro.text: The leader of an outlaw gang in the Roughs, whose men have standing orders to shoot Wax and Lessie on sight.

items.text: Wax and Lessie clashed with Donal's crew many times. During a railcar robbery Wax shot Donal's brother in self-defence, and Lessie shot Donal's son, who lived but lost a toe; in return Donal told his men to kill the pair whenever they saw them.

When Bloody Tan stole a shipment of bendalloy from him, Donal offered a bounty for Tan and set his men on his trail; they arrived in Feltrel the same day Wax and Lessie did, and Wax, though tempted to let the gang and Tan fight it out, decided against it.

personality.text: He seems to care for his son but disliked the brother Wax killed, so his order for revenge may have been a matter of pride. Above all, he hates losing money.
